summary: Fees were included by both sides in the first round and were negotiated alongside class relief before any final settlement of the class fund. The transcript explicitly links fee allocation to class recovery when class counsel considers shifting $1 million from fees to the class fund. Class counsel considered its own investment in evaluating fees, but the transcript does not show counsel prioritizing the firm over the class, defense exploiting fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
